records.question: 订单明细一共有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_total FROM order_items;

records.question: 数据库里一共有多少个客户?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_name) AS distinct_names FROM customers;

records.question: 2014 年一共下了多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2014'

records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country AS country, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2014%'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS line_cnt FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_typo,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

records.question: Consumer 类型的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT sub_category, item_rows, ROUND(avg_discount, 4) AS avg_discount FROM (SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, AVG(oi.discount) AS avg_discount FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.sub_category) ORDER BY avg_discount DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: 利润为负的亏损明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN profit IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_profit FROM order_items;

records.question: 运费最高的 5 行明细,列出行号和运费。
records.sql: SELECT row_id, shipping_cost FROM order_items ORDER BY shipping_cost DESC LIMIT 5;

records.question: 美国的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM customers WHERE country = 'United States';

records.question: 2013 年 12 月的总销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_sales_rows, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2013-12'

records.question: 下单次数最多的 3 个客户,列出客户编号和订单数。
records.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 3;

records.question: Technology 大类平均每行明细的销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_count, COUNT(oi.sales) AS sales_rows, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(AVG(oi.sales),2) AS avg_sales_per_line FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Technology'

records.question: 折扣不低于 0.3 的明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_items WHERE discount >= 0.3

records.question: 每种配送方式各有多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT ship_mode, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY ship_mode ORDER BY order_cnt DESC;

records.question: 数量小于等于 0 的异常明细有哪些行号?
records.sql: SELECT row_id, order_id, product_id, sales, quantity, discount, profit, shipping_cost FROM "order_items" WHERE quantity <= 0 ORDER BY row_id;

records.question: 各市场的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY total_profit DESC

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2013-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01' GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit)/SUM(oi.sales),4) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL AND oi.sales > 0 GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY margin DESC

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(i.profit) AS total_profit, SUM(i.sales) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(i.profit)/SUM(i.sales), 4) AS margin, COUNT(*) AS items FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY margin

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, ROUND(SUM(order_amt), 2) AS total_sales, ROUND(AVG(order_amt), 2) AS avg_order_amt, ROUND(MIN(order_amt),2) AS min_amt, ROUND(MAX(order_amt),2) AS max_amt
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.sales) AS order_amt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate'
    AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales, MAX(n) AS cnt FROM t WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2, (n+2)/2)

records.question: 每种订单优先级各有多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT order_priority, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY order_priority ORDER BY order_cnt DESC;

records.question: 总利润最高的 5 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 5;

records.question: 2015 年 7 月到 12 月的总销售额是多少?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2015-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2015-12-31'

records.question: First Class 配送方式的平均运费是多少?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS line_cnt, ROUND(AVG(shipping_cost), 2) AS avg_line_shipping, ROUND(MIN(shipping_cost),2) AS min_ship, ROUND(MAX(shipping_cost),2) AS max_ship FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE ship_mode = 'First Class')

records.question: 销售额缺失(sales 为空)的明细有哪些行号?
records.sql: SELECT row_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, discount, profit, shipping_cost FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NULL ORDER BY row_id;

records.question: 哪些订单的发货日期早于下单日期?列出订单号。
records.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.ship_date, o.ship_mode, o.order_priority, c.customer_name, c.country
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.ship_date IS NOT NULL AND date(o.ship_date) < date(o.order_date)
ORDER BY o.order_id;

records.question: region 为空的客户有哪些客户编号?
records.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, country, region FROM customers WHERE region IS NULL OR region = ''

records.question: 剔除数量为 0 或负数、销售额为空的异常明细后,总销售额是多少?
records.sql:

FROM order_items
WHERE quantity > 0 AND sales IS NOT NULL

records.question: 每种客户类型(segment)各有多少个客户?
records.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt FROM customers GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customer_cnt DESC;

records.question: 各市场分别有多少个客户?
records.sql: SELECT g.market AS market, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_cnt FROM customers c JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region GROUP BY g.market ORDER BY customer_cnt DESC

records.question: 2012 年每个月各有多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2012-%' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

records.question: 销售额最高的 5 行明细,列出行号和销售额。
records.sql: SELECT row_id, sales FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 5;

records.question: 客户数量最多的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, c.country
LIMIT 5;

records.question: 三个商品大类各有多少张订单(按订单号去重)?
records.sql:
SELECT p.category AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC;

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.sales),2) AS sales, ROUND(SUM(i.profit),2) AS profit, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN i.profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_lines, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.profit < 0 THEN i.profit ELSE 0 END),2) AS loss_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

records.question: 按配送方式统计总销售额。
records.sql: SELECT o.ship_mode, ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY o.ship_mode ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

records.question: 没有任何商品明细的订单有几张?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_without_items
FROM orders AS o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items AS oi
    WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
);

records.question: 折扣正好为 0 的明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items) AS total FROM order_items WHERE discount = 0;

records.question: 库里最早和最晚的订单日期分别是哪天?
records.sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS earliest, MAX(order_date) AS latest, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders;

records.question: 累计消费总额最高的 3 个客户,列出客户编号和消费总额。
records.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(i.sales),2) AS total_sales FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 3;

records.question: 各国家的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country AS country, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items AS oi
INNER JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_profit DESC

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market AS market,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY margin_pct DESC;

records.question: Technology 大类 2014 年的总销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.product_id WHERE p.category='Technology' AND strftime('%Y',o.order_date)='2014';

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, COUNT(*) AS items, AVG(oi.profit) AS avg_profit, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit
FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY avg_profit;

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01' GROUP BY p.sub_category HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0 ORDER BY total_profit ASC
